explanation: Mathlib has no Dirichlet-domain theorem (its FundamentalDomain file even notes this as a TODO). I checked the fundamental-domain constructors such as `MeasureTheory.IsFundamentalDomain.mk'` and `mk''`; they require uniqueness or almost-disjointness hypotheses not present directly here, so obtaining this result from them would require proving the geometric and measure-theoretic ingredients rather than routine glue. The target proof instead establishes the required fields directly.
